chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from one of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Hisham, from Muyassar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The gratefulness of the bounties is keeping away from the prohibitions, and the completion of the gratefulness is the speech of the man (saying) 'The Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds'.

key_terms.الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ: The Praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of true gratitude for God's bounties according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a hierarchical understanding of gratitude, distinguishing between the foundational act of avoiding sins as a form of thankfulness and the ultimate perfection of gratitude through verbal praise. This teaching underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the integration of practical obedience (abstaining from *al-maharim*) with spiritual devotion, linking the recitation of Surah Al-Fatiha directly to the completion of one's thankfulness for divine bounties. The narration highlights that true gratitude is not merely emotional but is manifested through both behavioral discipline and liturgical affirmation of God's lordship.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from one of our companions, from Muhammad Bin Hisham, from Muyassar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Gratefulness of the Bounties is keeping away from the Prohibitions, and the completion of the gratefulness is the speech of the man (saying) ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the worlds’’.
en.sarwar: 10. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from certain individuals of our people from Muhammad ibn Hisham from Muyassir from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Not to commit unlawful acts is a form of expressing thanks for a bounty. A complete expression of thankfulness is that one says, “All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds.””’
